svg.text: KRUZE Coffee & Tea Omnichannel Management System

g.text: • Three-interface architecture: Admin Dashboard, POS System, and E-Commerce Storefront
• Clean architecture pattern with layered backend services (Routes → Services → Storage → Database)
• Comprehensive inventory tracking with stock movement reasons (BUY, SELL, ROAST, CORRECTION)
• Dual pricing system: B2B (with invoice numbers) and B2C (guest checkout)
• Customer-specific pricing overrides for B2B clients
• Automated stock movements upon: Sale status update, Supplier order confirmation, Roast creation
• Professional PDF invoice generation with Belgian VAT compliance (6% & 21% rates)
• Coffee roasting workflow: Green coffee → Roast batch → Roasted product (with stock tracking)
• Frontend: React 18.3, TypeScript 5.6, Vite 5.4, TailwindCSS 3.4, Radix UI, TanStack Query 5.90
• Backend: Node.js, Express 4.21, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM 0.39, Passport.js
• Database: PostgreSQL (Neon serverless) with WebSocket connection pooling
• Authentication: Replit Auth (OpenID Connect) with 7-day session TTL
• Security: Helmet, CORS, Rate Limiting, CSRF protection, Input validation
• Integrations: Resend (email), PDFKit (invoice generation), Replit Connectors (credential management)
